ruling: - **R11.** Owner 16:00 CST Nov 10: "A -- but also i kinda meant how when questions reach triage, do the pre tool question use stuff run on it just like it would when uqestions used to come in line in the chats?". docs/catalog.md (lint/hook_catalog.py) lists all 36 hooks but no permissions, autoMode rules, env, cloud-only allow rules, githooks or mod events. It grows to every hook and setting with a "runs on" column (Mac, Windows, cloud), and the page's Status tab links it. Audit holes to close: H1 GitHub MCP writes never reach the guard (settings.json matcher; fixed in stage 1). H2 unarmed clones commit env files; H3 hooks fail open on a partial install. H4 a repo's disableAllHooks is unwatched; H5 no rm shim on Windows; H6 decision watch desktop-only. Page questions: ArtifactData writes run the same question form (guard.py) and judge (call_judge.py, past rulings included) as the chat box. Home: decision hook-catalog-page. Coordinator 13:00 CST Nov 11: a long cloud session keeps the hooks installed at its start. Its copy lacked lane-effort-pin (10e38b0ae, 13:40 CST Nov 10) until a reinstall at 12:50 CST Nov 11, so 7 of 7 lanes read started with a bare "/effort medium" and the brief came later. Owner 12:59 CST: "its weird a lane can be spawned without its brief first preprovided". A session whose installed hooks are older than main says so at its next turn and reinstalls; the fresh start clears it once. Owner 13:10 CST: "maybe we enforce cloud sessions to restart often mechanically based on certain conditions like certain items landing on main". Read 13:11 CST (decision idle-resume-compacts): the cloud reruns the install at each worker restart, which follows an idle gap. A busy session never restarts, so only it goes stale. Owner 13:21 CST: "yes sorry i meant reinstall not restart i agree". When hooks or settings on main changed since the install, the session reinstalls at its next turn, in place, with no restart. It restarts only for a change a reinstall cannot load. Whether a new hook entry in settings.json loads without a restart is unmeasured; a lane measures it first.
